# BizLocalPilot AI

> BizLocalPilot AI is an all-in-one local search authority and Google My Business (GMB) optimization platform designed for modern brands, agency owners, multi-location businesses, healthcare providers, and hospitality services in India and globally.

## Core Features
- **AI Review Auto-Responses**: Powered by Google Gemini AI, generates contextual, professional, and SEO-rich review replies tailored specifically for your industry (hospitality, healthcare, retail, professional services).
- **GMB Post Campaign Scheduler**: Automated weekly post drafting, promotions, and holiday greeting scheduler that keeps local customers engaged and signals active profile status to Google Maps ranking algorithms.
- **Local SEO Competitor Tracker**: Tracks competitor rankings, primary categories, review velocity, and local pack visibility to identify growth opportunities.
- **Automated Local Audit Reports**: Generates instant GMB audit scores, missing profile information alerts, and actionable recommendations.
- **DPDP Act 2023 Compliant**: Built strictly adhering to India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act with complete user data privacy and single-click data erasure.

## Target Audience
Local business owners, local SEO agencies, digital marketing consultants, restaurant chains, dental clinics, retail stores, and multi-location enterprises looking to boost local search rankings and automate customer review management.
